topic: The search for the perfect cup of chai.

episode.title: Chacha Jee Ki Perfect Chai

shots.narration: چچا بہترین چائے بنائیں گے، مگر یہ ترازو کیوں نکالا؟
shots.scene: Bright Pakistani kitchen, sunny yellow walls, vertical 9:16 composition, stylized 3D animated comedy look, no text or labels.
shots.action: Chacha places a large balance scale beside a tiny empty teacup.
shots.mood: Chacha beams proudly; Pappu watches with raised eyebrows.

shots.narration: پپو، بہترین چائے اندازے سے نہیں، حساب سے بنتی ہے!
shots.scene: Same sunny kitchen counter, loose tea in an unmarked bowl, balance scale and tiny cup, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Chacha carefully lowers one tea leaf onto the balance scale.
shots.mood: Exaggerated concentration on Chacha's face; patient amusement on Pappu's.

shots.narration: پھر دودھ بھی قطرہ قطرہ ناپا جانے لگا!
shots.scene: Kitchen stove with a small saucepan, plain milk jug and an oversized spoon nearby, bright 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no markings.
shots.action: Chacha drips milk from a tiny spoon into the saucepan.
shots.mood: Chacha looks grandly scientific; Pappu's shoulders sag with boredom.

shots.narration: چچا، چائے بن رہی ہے یا کل کا ناشتہ؟
shots.scene: Same kitchen, saucepan on the stove behind the characters, warm sunshine, vertical 9:16, no visible writing.
shots.action: Pappu holds an empty teacup directly beneath Chacha's nose.
shots.mood: Pappu wears a patient half-smile; Chacha remains stubbornly serious.

shots.narration: بس خوشبو کم ہے، تھوڑی پتی اور صحیح!
shots.scene: Close view of the kitchen stove and steaming saucepan, unmarked tea bowl beside it, vertical 9:16, colorful 3D film look.
shots.action: Chacha tips a heaped spoonful of tea leaves into the saucepan.
shots.mood: Chacha looks completely certain; Pappu's eyes widen.

shots.narration: پہلا گھونٹ آیا، تو مونچھیں بھی گھبرا گئیں!
shots.scene: Kitchen counter with a cup of extremely dark tea and abandoned measuring utensils, vertical 9:16, no labels or text.
shots.action: Chacha takes a tiny sip of the dark tea.
shots.mood: Chacha's cheeks pucker dramatically beneath his moustache; Pappu looks knowingly

shots.narration: چچی بولیں، ذرا ہٹو، مجھے بھی چائے پینی ہے!
shots.scene: Another section of the same kitchen counter, plain teapot and clean cups, warm sunny 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Chachi pours creamy golden chai from a plain teapot into a cup.
shots.mood: Chachi looks calmly confident; Chacha watches with skeptical eyebrows.

shots.narration: چچا نے چچی کی چائے چکھی، اور ترازو ہٹا دیا!
shots.scene: Kitchen counter, half-full golden chai cup before Chacha, balance scale beside it, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Chacha slides his balance scale away from Chachi's golden chai.
shots.mood: Chacha smiles sheepishly; Chachi wears a victorious smile; Pappu grins.

shots.narration: چائے چچی کی، دعوے چچا کے؛ اگلا تجربہ پنکھے پر!
shots.scene: Sunny kitchen dining nook, Chachi seated with her golden chai, a small tabletop fan with its unplugged cord clearly visible, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Chacha proudly lifts the unplugged tabletop fan onto the table.
shots.mood: Chacha's swagger has returned; Chachi smiles knowingly over her cup; Pappu looks

episode.endHook: Chai ke baad ab pankhay par Chacha Jee ka tajurba!
episode.description: چچا جی بہترین چائے بنانے نکلے تو باورچی خانہ تجربہ گاہ بن گیا۔ پپو دیکھتا رہ گیا، مگر چچی جان کی سادہ سی چائے نے میدان مار لیا!
